    export interface DiagramBox {
        x: number;

  DiagramBridge (packages/module-diagrams/src/geometry.ts)
    export interface DiagramBridge extends DiagramPoint {
        segment: number;
        radius: 6;
        over: string;
    }
  DiagramCheckResult (packages/module-diagrams/src/check.ts)
    export interface DiagramCheckResult {
        schema_version: 1;
        valid: boolean;
        type: DiagramSpec["type"] | null;
        errors: DiagramFinding[];
        warnings: DiagramFinding[];
    }
  DiagramConnector (packages/module-diagrams/src/geometry.ts)
    export interface DiagramConnector {
        kind: "connector";
        id: string;
        edge: number;
        from: DiagramPort;
        to: DiagramPort;
        points: DiagramPoint[];
        path: string;
        radius: 8;
        bridges: DiagramBridge[];
        dashed: boolean;
        transit: string[];
    }
  DiagramEdgeLabel (packages/module-diagrams/src/geometry.ts)
    export interface DiagramEdgeLabel extends DiagramBox {
        kind: "edge-label";
        edge: number;
        text: string;
        fontSize: number;
    }

    export type DiagramElement = DiagramConnector | DiagramLabelMask | DiagramEdgeLabel | DiagramNode | DiagramGroup;
